title: Summarize agency monthly evidence amounts within authorized page groups
description: A customer-service user sees original-currency amount subtotals for the month or customer groups on the authorized current agency monthly report page. Extend ERP-184 group summaries from the same underlying scoped ERP-180 rows, never from a client-projected field list. Sum registered original-currency amounts separately from draft and void amounts, retain currency precision and the no-proration rule, and label every subtotal as page-only evidence rather than revenue or receivables. No cross-currency or cross-page total is allowed. Recheck current-user menu and salesperson scope on every preview; invalid group, filters or page bounds fail closed before source reads and existing operation logging remains. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Use temporary locations for manual test output and verify focused tests plus safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: ERP-184 month and customer group summaries include separate registered, draft and void original-currency amounts derived only from the same authorized current-page monthly rows, independent of selected display columns.

Each subtotal keeps its currency and precision, does not cross currencies or pages, and carries page-only evidence and no-proration meaning; revoked access, bad grouping and invalid filters fail closed.
Focused tests cover exact decimals, mixed currencies, status separation, hidden amount fields, empty and truncated pages, denied scope and read-only behavior; safe Release build/test passes.
